name: Digital Agency
description: A digital agency helping local businesses with social media content creation, management, and engagement-driven posting strategies.
mission: Help local businesses grow their online presence through quality, relevant social media content that drives real engagement.

canva.description: Visual design — Instagram posts, carousels, stories, Facebook posts.

moda.setupCommand: claude mcp add --transport http moda https://mcp.moda.app
moda.description: Primary visual design tool — AI-generated editable social media graphics.

trello.description: Content pipeline — Trello cards for each post, workflow stages.

publer.description: Social media scheduling — each client has their own Publer workspace.

agents.name: Account Director
agents.description: Oversees all client accounts. Prioritizes work, delegates tasks, reviews pipeline status, and compiles weekly client reports.

agents.name: Competitor Analyst
agents.description: Researches competitor social media profiles, identifies trending topics and content gaps, and delivers opportunity reports for each client.

config.note: Stays on Claude — needs web search and nuanced analysis

agents.name: Content Strategist
agents.description: Builds weekly content plans from research. Creates Trello cards for each post with topic, format, platform, and visual direction.

config.note: Runs locally — uses Trello MCP via OpenCode

agents.name: Content Writer
agents.description: Writes social media post copy, captions, and hashtag sets tailored to each client's brand voice, audience, and platform.

config.note: Stays on Claude — quality copy requires strong language skills

agents.name: Visual Designer
agents.description: Creates social media visuals in Moda. Generates images, carousels, and stories based on approved copy and visual direction.

config.note: Runs locally — uses Moda MCP via OpenCode

agents.name: Fact Checker
agents.description: Verifies claims, statistics, and information in post copy before it reaches QA. Checks against client profile compliance rules.

config.note: Runs locally — rule-based checking against client profiles

agents.name: Publishing Agent
agents.description: After Jason's approval in Trello, pushes posts to the correct Publer workspace. Reads Trello Approved list, calls Publer API, moves card to Published.

config.note: Runs locally — uses Trello MCP + Publer API via OpenCode

workflow.description: Social media content pipeline — always keep 4+ weeks of content ahead for every client
workflow.humanGate: Jason reviews all content in 'In Review'. Only cards he moves to 'Approved' go to Publer. Nothing auto-posts.
workflow.humanCheckpoints: Jason has 3 checkpoints: (1) Reviews Content Calendar cards before moving to Fact Check, (2) Downloads Moda assets and reviews completed content before moving to Approved, (3) Nothing auto-posts — Publishing Agent only acts on Approved cards.

formatRotation.pattern: Alternate Week A and Week B

contentCalendar.crossPlatform: Same post content used across all platforms the client is on, unless client profile specifies different per-platform rules

stages.name: Content Calendar
stages.output: Trello cards with topics, formats, copy, visual direction, and content pillars — 4 posts per week, 8-12 weeks out
stages.note: Content Strategist (with research from Competitor Analyst) creates cards and writes the post copy, captions, hashtags directly on each card. Always maintain 4+ weeks ahead.

stages.name: Fact Check
stages.output: Verified content — claims, compliance, and accuracy checked
stages.trigger: JASON moves cards from Content Calendar to Fact Check after reviewing the planned content
stages.note: Jason reviews Content Calendar cards. If the content looks good, he moves the card to Fact Check. The Fact Checker then verifies claims and compliance per the client profile. Once cleared, Fact Checker moves the card to In Production.

stages.name: In Production
stages.output: Moda visuals created for image and carousel posts. Video cards get scripts only.
stages.note: Visual Designer creates image/carousel assets in Moda. Adds a comment to the card when assets are ready for Jason to download. Video cards: Jason's team creates the video assets manually. Cards stay here until all assets are complete.

stages.name: In Review
stages.output: Completed content with all assets, waiting for Jason's final review
stages.note: Visual Designer moves completed cards here and notifies Jason that Moda assets are ready to download. Jason downloads the assets from Moda, attaches them to the Trello card or saves to a folder. Jason reviews everything — copy, visuals, compliance.

stages.name: Approved
stages.output: Publishing Agent detects cards in Approved and pushes to Publer
stages.trigger: JASON moves cards from In Review to Approved after downloading assets and final review
stages.note: Jason moves the card to Approved in Trello. The Publishing Agent picks it up and pushes the content to the correct Publer workspace as a draft. Card moves to Published.

stages.name: Published
stages.output: Post added to correct Publer workspace
stages.note: Card is in Publer. Content is scheduled or drafted.

stages.name: Archive
stages.note: Every Monday, previous week's Published cards move to Archive.

routines.name: morning-briefing
routines.description: Account Director checks all client Trello boards: How many weeks ahead is each client? Any cards stuck in In Production? Anything in In Review waiting for Jason? Any Approved cards waiting for Publer? Flags gaps and blockers.

routines.name: monday-archive
routines.description: Move all previous week's cards from Published to Archive across all client boards. Verify current week has content in the pipeline.

routines.name: competitor-research
routines.description: Competitor Analyst researches competitor profiles and trending topics for all clients. Feeds findings to Content Strategist for calendar planning.

routines.name: calendar-fill
routines.description: Content Strategist checks each client's Content Calendar depth. If any client has fewer than 4 weeks ahead, create new weekly cards with topics, formats, visual direction, and content pillars. Target: 8-12 weeks out.

routines.name: content-production
routines.description: Content Writer picks up cards from Content Calendar, writes full post copy, captions, hashtags, and moves them to In Production. Follows each client's profile for tone, compliance, and platform rules.

routines.name: visual-production
routines.description: Visual Designer picks up image and carousel cards from In Production, creates visuals in Moda, attaches them to the card. Video cards get scripts but are flagged for manual production. Completed cards move to In Review.

routines.name: fact-check-sweep
routines.description: Fact Checker reviews all cards in the Fact Check list — verifies claims, topics, and compliance per the client profile BEFORE production begins. Cards pass to In Production only after clearing fact check. This prevents wasted work on non-compliant content.

routines.name: publish-approved
routines.description: Publishing Agent checks the Approved list on each client's Trello board. Any card Jason has moved there is ready to go — push it to the correct Publer workspace as a draft and move the Trello card to Published.

routines.name: weekly-client-report
routines.description: Account Director compiles weekly summary per client: content calendar depth, posts published this week, cards in pipeline, any gaps or issues for next week.
